title: vania kurdica
intro: Vania kurdica, commonly known as the Kurdish root or Kurdish valerian, is a plant species of the genus Vania, which belongs to the family Apiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Vania kurdica include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions such as insomnia, restlessness, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Vania kurdica include valerenic acid, isovalerenic acid, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
